title: Trail and Rivergate
author: Casper Nystrom
blurb: Casper Halloran, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. But when a dying prospector trades a map for a promise, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
